name: Sonic similarity
author: Thilo Utke
description: Similar tracks and Instant Mix from MusicNN audio embeddings computed by the navidrome-sonic sidecar

http.reason: Query the navidrome-sonic sidecar, a private address on the Docker network

matcher.reason: Resolve a track ID to the file size, duration and title the sidecar looks it up by

library.reason: Navidrome requires it for the matcher; no filesystem access
